DOC011-C001.target_statement: 与队友异步协作修改同一份代码，完成课程与项目作业。
DOC011-C001.label: direct
DOC011-C001.rationale: T023 在回答「主要用 GitHub 做什么」时直接给出团队协作，并说明异步性质：「we are asynchronous collab, asynchronously collaborating on this code」。
supported_parts: 主要用途：T024「from my student perspective is like team collaboration」
异步协作：T024「asynchronously collaborating on this code」
共同写权限：T024「It's not just me who has access to update this online folder」
unsupported_parts: 未说明团队规模与协作频率
「异步」的具体机制（时区、节奏）未说明
reasoning_steps: 2. 对象（队友、同一仓库）与条件（异步）一致

DOC011-C002.target_statement: 代码合并进主分支前必须经他人审查，防止未审改动进入主干。
DOC011-C002.label: direct
DOC011-C002.rationale: T083 明确把 PR 的价值说成「make sure that the main repository stays safe from unknown code changes before they are reviewed by others」，T031-T033 补充审查标准与拒绝机制。
supported_parts: 目的：T084「stays safe from unknown code changes before they are reviewed」
标准：T032「up to standard of the team or their personal standard」
拒绝：T034「they can also be denied if they don't meet the standards」
unsupported_parts: 未说明审查人数要求或超时规则
未说明紧急情况下是否允许绕过
reasoning_steps: 2. 审查流程在 T029-T033 有具体描述

DOC011-C003.target_statement: 改动按小步增量提交，减少协作者每次要审查的内容量。
DOC011-C003.label: direct
DOC011-C003.rationale: T043 明确偏好并给出理由：「I personally prefer to do it incrementally, because it... provides less content for my collaborators to have to review」。
supported_parts: 偏好：T044「I personally prefer to do it incrementally」
理由：T044「provides less content for my collaborators to have to review」
unsupported_parts: 有明确例外：独自开发时不用 PR、倾向大改动（T046）
未定义「增量」的粒度

DOC011-C004.target_statement: 能回看仓库的变更历史，包括每次提交改了什么、由谁改。
DOC011-C004.label: direct
DOC011-C004.rationale: T083 说 PR「is also a very convenient way to track history」，并说明可看每次 PR 改了什么以及协作者的改动。
supported_parts: 历史追踪：T084「a very convenient way to track history」
内容：T084「what changes were made with this pull request」
协作者改动：T084「changes that were made by my collaborators」
unsupported_parts: 现有历史为线性提交栈，分支结构不可见（T087 指出）
未说明需要筛选或导出
reasoning_steps: 2. 与 C010 的不足描述对照

DOC011-C005.target_statement: 代码安全保存在云端，本机损坏或丢失时可换机拉取继续。
DOC011-C005.label: direct
DOC011-C005.rationale: T075 明确云端保存的目的与场景：「having a convenient place to store my code in a in a in a safe manner」，本机故障时可「pull onto a different machine」。
supported_parts: 目的：T076「store my code in a in a in a safe manner」
恢复场景：T076「I would still have my work in a cloud environment」
换机继续：T076「pull onto a different machine and continue working」
unsupported_parts: 未说明私有仓库的可见性与备份策略
未讨论误删恢复

DOC011-C006.target_statement: 检索并阅读他人公开仓库的代码。
DOC011-C006.label: direct
DOC011-C006.rationale: T081 说明平台开放性「public repositories are visible to anybody」，并描述搜索与筛选方式。
supported_parts: 开放性：T082「public repositories are visible to anybody」
检索范围：T082「search the entire Github database for public repositories」
语言筛选：T082「I can also filter based on language」
unsupported_parts: 未说明检索用途（学习/复用/找工作）
未提及私有仓库边界
reasoning_steps: 1. 取开放性陈述与检索描述
2. 用途未明但行为与目的清楚

DOC011-C007.target_statement: 用看板跟踪任务状态与分工（backlog → 待办 → 进行中）。
DOC011-C007.label: direct
DOC011-C007.rationale: T053 定义项目为「a tracking board... Kanban board where you're actually assigning tasks」，T059 描述 backlog 到待办的流转与分工会议。
supported_parts: 定义：T054「a project is essentially just a tracking board」
分工：T054「assigning tasks, and you can facilitate team management」
流转：T060「move those issues... from the backlog to another part of the combine board」
unsupported_parts: 未说明看板列的具体定义（待办/进行中/完成）
未说明是否需要进度统计
reasoning_steps: 2. 流转流程在 T060-T062 有描述

DOC011-C008.target_statement: PR 与看板 issue 关联，合并后看板状态自动更新。
DOC011-C008.label: direct
DOC011-C008.rationale: T069 明确联动效果：「when that port request is merged, the Kanban board would automatically reflect that」，并说明通过 resolves 关键词关联。
supported_parts: 自动更新：T070「the Kanban board would automatically reflect that」
关联方式：T070「you can actually attach it to an issue in the Kanban board」
unsupported_parts: 依赖项目已链接仓库（T068），未说明未链接时的行为
关键词的具体语法未完整给出
reasoning_steps: 1. 取联动效果与关联方式
2. 前置条件已由受访者说明

DOC011-C009.target_statement: GitHub Actions 的官方文档更易查，并提供讨论区或博客。
DOC011-C009.label: direct
DOC011-C009.rationale: T085 指出 Actions 文档难查「It's very difficult to find」，并直接提出改进形态（forum、blog、讨论区）。
supported_parts: 问题：T086「their documentation overall is a little broad」与「It's very difficult to find」
期望：T086「a forum or such, or like a a blog, tab forward discussions」
旁证：T086「most of the documentation, I find is from other external sources」
unsupported_parts: 未说明期望的文档结构或示例数量
「broad」的含义（覆盖面广 vs 表述含糊）未澄清
reasoning_steps: 1. 取问题陈述与期望形态
2. 二者同一段内直接相连

DOC011-C010.target_statement: 以可视化方式呈现分支创建与合并的历史，而不只是线性提交栈。
DOC011-C010.label: direct
DOC011-C010.rationale: T087 明确提出「a visual mapping of the repository history」，并说明现有提交栈不足、期望看到分支与合并位置。
supported_parts: 期望：T088「a visual mapping of the repository history」
内容：T088「where they were merged in」
现状不足：T088「doesn't give like a an exact history of the repository」
unsupported_parts: 受访者自称「not an essential feature... Nice to have」，强度弱
未说明图形形态（有向图/时间轴）

DOC011-C011.target_statement: 内置 AI 助手，辅助代码审查与操作引导，并帮用户用上平台已有的资源。
DOC011-C011.label: direct
DOC011-C011.rationale: T093 与 T097 两次提出 AI 集成：前者是「consult with it to have better to use all the resources available on Github」，后者具体到代码审查与操作引导。
supported_parts: 集成设想：T094「integrate such an assistant to allow users to consult with it」
审查辅助：T098「help me with code reviews, provide suggestions」
操作引导：T098「guide me through. maybe making a pull request」
动机：T098「I have another source of feedback」
unsupported_parts: 未说明 AI 与人工审查的关系（替代还是补充）
未说明对 AI 建议的信任边界
reasoning_steps: 2. 用途覆盖审查与操作两类
